title: Autoplay must be turned off for non-volume devices.
check_content:
If the following registry value does not exist or is not configured as specified, this is a finding:

Registry Hive: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE
Registry Path: \SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\

Value Name: NoAutoplayfornonVolume

Value Type: REG_DWORD
Value: 1
fixtext: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> AutoPlay Policies >> "Disallow Autoplay for non-volume devices" to "Enabled".
VulnDiscussion: Allowing autoplay to execute may introduce malicious code to a system.  Autoplay begins reading from a drive as soon as you insert media in the drive.  As a result, the setup file of programs or music on audio media may start.  This setting will disable autoplay for non-volume devices (such as Media Transfer Protocol (MTP) devices).
